question: The mode of the observations 20, 20, 20, 35, 29, 34, 25, 33, 35, 32, 33, 27, 22, 31 and 31 is:
solution:
**Given:**

Observations = 20, 20, 20, 35, 29, 34, 25, 33, 35, 32, 33, 27, 22, 31, 31

**Formula used:**

Mode: The mode of a set of observations is the number that occurs most frequently.

**Calculation:**

Frequency of each observation:

 
• 20 → 3 times
 
• 35 → 2 times
 
• 29 → 1 time
 
• 34 → 1 time
 
• 25 → 1 time
 
• 33 → 2 times
 
• 32 → 1 time
 
• 27 → 1 time
 
• 22 → 1 time
 
• 31 → 2 times

 

The observation with the highest frequency is 20.

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
